FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE MEMBER OF THE
MORATUWA MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
UNDER SECTION 65A(2) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
(CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BYLOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS the office of a member in Moratuwa Municipal Council has fallen vacant by reason of death ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the recognized political party namely United People's Freedom Alliance towhich the former member, Wedige Nimal Yasasiri Peiris belonged was required by me under Section 65A(2) of theaforesaid Ordinance, to nominate within a period of thirty (30) days, a person eligible under the ordinance for election asa member of that Moratuwa Municipal Council who shall be declared elected as a member ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has nominated Mr. MahamarakkalageBerty Ishan Suranga Perera being an eligible person under the aforesaid Ordinance to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Saman Sri Rathnayake, Returning Officer of Moratuwa Municipal Council acting interms of Section 65A(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of vacancies in Local Authorities(Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr. Mahamarakkalage Berty Ishan SurangaPerera elected as a member of the Moratuwa Municipal Council.
SAMAN SRI RATHNAYAKE,
Returning Officer,Moratuwa Municipal Council.City Elections Office,Colombo,13th May, 2016.
